The '''''Shekelesh''-class freight gunship''' was a model of [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] manufactured by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and frequently used by [[Moogan/Legends|Moogans]], earning it the names '''Moogan cargo ship''' and '''Moogan smuggler ship'''.

==Characteristics and Description==
[[File:Sundari_Shipping_Docks.png|thumb|left|220px|A ''Shekelesh''-class gunship on Mandalore]]
The shape of the gunship was tall and curved and its landing gear comprised of six [[Insect/Legends|insect]]-like segmented legs, similar to those of the [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]]. These legs were used to walk on the ground when the ship landed. While in walk-mode, it could scuttle away to avoid [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] or other authorities. The design of the ship decreased the time it took to unload the ship, with the cargo hold located in its lower belly.<ref name="IV" />

==History==
[[File:MooganGunship-Corruption.png|thumb|left|130px|In mid-flight]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a party of [[Moogan/Legends|Moogans]] and [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]], led by the Moogan [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] [[Tea/Legends|tea]] to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], which after being [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] with [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]] ended up in the hands of its [[Youngling/Legends|children]].<ref name="Corruption">{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}}</ref>

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], more Moogans were seen to unload at the time when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] landed on [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] to rescue [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]].
